headline: Bullhorn takes staffing platform offline after cyberattack
summary: Staffing software company Bullhorn disabled access to its platform to contain a cyberattack that caused a system-wide outage, leaving customers facing login problems. The company has called in CrowdStrike to help respond, and questions remain over whether customer data was stolen.
